hook: Help turns its head. The hammer drops.
lines: Hammer. The 1 on the right wing, the 5 at the elbow, the shooter left.
The 5 screens, and the 1 drives the baseline.
The 4 screens the shooter's man while he sags into the paint.
The 1 skips it across the baseline, under the help.
Corner three. His man is twelve feet away at the catch.
When weak-side help sags to the drive, hammer it and skip.
